connections.feedback: Late fees can matter a lot financially, so do not assume an omission is minor. Read the contract's own words.
A missing clause is a warning that the summary may be incomplete. The contract is the authority, so read the relevant section yourself.
A knowledgeable person such as a manager or colleague could check it, and that is wise for contracts. But the first move when you spot a gap is to compare it with the text yourself.

Knowing the rules is part of doing this properly, and some workplaces require approved tools. But the question asks for the best approach to the task, and removing details is the step that works within almost any rule.
